long_biography.plain_text:
Oleg Burlakov trained in military aviation engineering before spending years in research and teaching. His technical work included aircraft electrical systems, and he led an equipment department at a military engineering school in Kharkiv. He later established Integral with former colleagues, turning their expertise into commercial research on fuel systems and spacecraft components.

A second venture, Sovinterfrance, moved from warehouse construction into trade. When a Kharkiv manufacturer lacked the funds to make pumps needed by oil producers, Burlakov and his partners bought the equipment and exchanged it for Russian crude. They then sold the oil to traders through an export business with a branch in Saint Petersburg.
long_biography.html:
Oleg Burlakov trained in military aviation engineering before spending years in research and teaching. His technical work included aircraft electrical systems, and he led an equipment department at a military engineering school in Kharkiv. He later established Integral with former colleagues, turning their expertise into commercial research on fuel systems and spacecraft components.

A second venture, Sovinterfrance, moved from warehouse construction into trade. When a Kharkiv manufacturer lacked the funds to make pumps needed by oil producers, Burlakov and his partners bought the equipment and exchanged it for Russian crude. They then sold the oil to traders through an export business with a branch in Saint Petersburg.
